title: Seasonal Workers Hand-Harvesting Potatoes, 1960s
description: In the 1960s, seasonal workers dug and hand-harvested potatoes. They picked potatoes on their hands and knees, filled a basket, and carried it to a barrel. About four filled baskets were needed to fill one barrel. After a picker filled a barrel, they placed a coloured tag on the barrel's edge. Collectors gathered these tags to determine pay; each full barrel earned 25 cents.
credit: Doris Kennedy Collection — Hartland Community Historical Society
